I mean we don't even get a decent wave 2 bounce or something, so I have to assume that the market is already in the third of a third wave to the downside, the orange scenario continues to be the leading scenario, and I continue to see absolutely no sign that a local low is in. And I can tell you that the next support levels are located at $1.75, that's going to be an important one and I'll tell you why in a minute, and $1.43 and $1.11. I said in one of the previous updates that the market is likely going to move towards the sub $1 area, so let's say below $1, and I said to you the next one is $1.75 and it's an important one. So it continues to be relevant. What can happen at any point is, however, for example, I would pay attention to these areas not to be surprised what can happen at any point is however for example i would i would pay attention to these areas not to be surprised eventually right but they could always be a larger wave two you know so technically we always have to give the market room to move into this resistance area and this resistance area again it's currently currently $234 and $3.06. We need to allow the market, even in this bearish scenario, to move into this resistance area at any point because a bounce is always possible. But for now, pressure is downward. I do not actively search for bullish setups here. There are other charts that still have a chance. And of course, I mean, don't get me wrong, I do not actively search for bullish setups here. There are other charts that still have a chance. Of course, I mean, don't get me wrong. Anything can always happen.
